one_line: Local Vakataka feudatory ruler and patron of Ajanta’s Cave 17–20 complex in the Waghora gorge.

appearance.age_look: Early 30s, lean but athletic build, medium height with a poised, disciplined stance.
appearance.face: Oval face with high cheekbones, straight nose, almond-shaped dark brown eyes, medium-brown Deccan complexion, a neatly trimmed short mustache, thin sideburns to mid-ear, and a calm, thoughtful default expression that shifts to firm resolve in tense moments.
appearance.hair: Black hair parted in the middle, pulled back smoothly and tied into a short, compact topknot at the crown; the head is encircled by a simple narrow gold diadem band with a small central green stone, worn over the hairline.
appearance.costume: He wears a Vakataka-era royal ensemble: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-style upper cloth wrapped diagonally over the left shoulder and across the torso, leaving the right arm free but fully covering the chest, paired with a saffron-gold silk dhoti tied high at the waist and pleated neatly to mid-calf; a broad maroon sash wraps the waist and knots at the left hip with the ends hanging; his feet wear simple brown leather sandals; his jewellery is restrained—two thin gold armlets on each upper arm, a single short gold necklace with a small circular pendant, and modest gold stud earrings; he wears plain bronze bangles on each wrist and a narrow dagger belt integrated into the waist sash.
appearance.signature: A sheathed, slightly curved iron sword with a simple bronze hilt and no guard, worn at his left hip through the maroon sash, with a dark brown leather scabbard reinforced by small bronze bands.

ref_desc: Upendragupta is a lean early-30s Deccan ruler with an oval face, short mustache, black hair in a compact topknot under a narrow gold diadem, wearing an off-white angavastra, saffron-gold dhoti, maroon sash, simple gold jewellery, sandals, and a sheathed curved iron sword at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of Upendragupta, a Vakataka-era feudatory ruler at Ajanta: a lean early-30s man of medium-brown Deccan complexion with an oval face, straight nose, high cheekbones, almond dark brown eyes, and a neatly trimmed short mustache with thin sideburns to mid-ear, his default expression calm and thoughtful but capable of firm resolve. His black hair is parted in the middle, pulled back smooth and tied into a short compact topknot at the crown, encircled by a simple narrow gold diadem band with a small central green stone resting over the hairline. He wears an era-accurate Vakataka royal costume: a knee-length off-white cotton angavastra-type upper cloth wrapped diagonally over the left shoulder and across the torso so the chest is modestly covered, leaving the right arm free, paired with a saffron-gold silk dhoti tied high at the waist, pleated neatly and hanging to mid-calf. Around his waist is a broad maroon sash wrapped snugly, knotted at the left hip with its ends hanging down, concealing a narrow dagger belt and serving as the support for his weapon. On his feet are simple brown leather sandals with straps over the instep. His jewellery is dignified and restrained: two thin gold armlets on each upper arm, a single short gold necklace with a small circular pendant, modest gold stud earrings, and plain bronze bangles on each wrist, with no excessive ornamentation. At his left hip, threaded through the maroon sash, hangs his signature weapon, a sheathed slightly curved iron sword with a simple bronze hilt and no guard, the dark brown leather scabbard reinforced by small bronze bands. Use a palette dominated by off-white, saffron-gold, maroon, brown leather, and warm gold, and show him from multiple angles to clearly present his face, hair, clothing, jewellery, sandals, and sword consistently.
